GeneralInfo.Name: MyTorrents
GeneralInfo.Author: Sohvaperuna, Edalex - 2026 update by Mark Willmer
GeneralInfo.ExtensionDescription: Finds and downloads TV episodes and movies for your MediaPortal library and files them where MP-TVSeries and Moving Pictures expect them. Works with qBittorrent, BiglyBT, Deluge, Transmission or uTorrent, searches through Jackett, and has a web page for your phone, tablet or laptop.
GeneralInfo.VersionDescription: 2026 update for MediaPortal 1.38 x64: - New in 1.3.81: MediaPortal's extension manager can tell you when a newer version is out - New in 1.3.80: a tooltip on every setting in Configuration, and the same help as a ? on the web page - New in 1.3.79: movie names Title, The (Year) [Score][Genre][Quality]; quality read from the video file (no 972p, x264/HEVC, AAC/AC3/EAC3...) - New in 1.3.78: names follow the HTPC Library Manager rules (characters, S01E01-E02, Subs folder, better copy = a quarter bigger) - New in 1.3.77: How MyTorrents works (Automatic / Manual) is now at the top of the Downloading tab - New in 1.3.76: Manual = only looks when you ask (show list kept); movie upgrades on/off; no doubles with other programs; Lupin whole-season fix - New in 1.3.75: Library tab renamed File management; changing the torrent program works straight away (no restart) - New in 1.3.74: Start fresh on the Check-up tab - MyTorrents looks for everything again with your settings (can be undone) - New in 1.3.73: Search sites and Torrent program tabs moved to the end (set once, rarely changed) - New in 1.3.72: no more mix-ups with same-named shows from another year (Lupin 1977); per-show choice to allow English-dubbed copies - New in 1.3.71: tabs grouped in the order a download goes through them; Downloading, Library and Torrent program; moved settings; no More settings window on TV shows - New in 1.3.70: MediaPortal Wanted movies shows only the movies still wanted, each with a short state so its name fits; the button is just Options - New in 1.3.69: the web page does everything Configuration does, with the same tabs; MediaPortal is simpler - Downloads, Wanted movies, Search and an always-visible Options button; dropped movies show up in Moving Pictures straight away - New in 1.3.68: the ... (look for a folder) buttons are back next to the folder boxes - the stretched boxes were covering them - New in 1.3.67: the last page says a MyTorrents window opens a few seconds after Finish (Jackett and your search sites) - that's normal; the window says MyTorrents is installed - New in 1.3.66: duplicates check never offers episodes with different air dates, season folders or titles as copies; Configuration opens on your last tab; a short season pack no longer blocks the missing episodes - New in 1.3.65: Poor copies and Stereo-only movies are one list - Movies to improve - with the buttons in each row and a Year column; each movie looks for the best it can (a poor stereo copy gets a better copy, 5.1 if there is one); hidden ones have their own list to put back - New in 1.3.64: web page - pressing a button further down a list (Find 5.1, Not this one, Add...) brings you back to the same spot, not the top - New in 1.3.63: age tags (18+, R18) left out of movie names; Use it now works again when the earlier copy has gone; show-folder and movie styles without the rating (When finished) - New in 1.3.62: Drop folder: when you already have everything in something you dropped in, the Check-up says so and offers Delete it - you have it all; packs already looked at aren't gone through again at every start - New in 1.3.61: Duplicates never treats different episodes (S01E04 / S02E01, part (1) / (3)) as copies - a wrong match in MP-TVSeries is shown as one; the desktop icon step finds the MediaPortal folder more safely - New in 1.3.60: Duplicates one at a time - which copy to keep, with the reason in plain words and big buttons, plus Do the easy ones for me; Check-up: pick several lines at once; every list sorts by clicking a heading (Wanted movies gets Year and Added); the desktop icon stays where you put it; movies everywhere (not films) - New in 1.3.59: Check-up -> Find duplicates: the same episode or movie twice, with the better copy to keep suggested; the others are set aside (nothing deleted until you say); Check-up buttons under the explanation; movies MCM renamed with a year either side are no longer flagged - New in 1.3.58: menus never loop when MediaPortal closes; setup recommends qBittorrent, with help for BiglyBT, uTorrent, Deluge and Transmission; ticked search sites at the top; Browse buttons for the Movies and Collections folders - New in 1.3.57: the Auto grabber only takes copies whose name starts with the show's name (no more other shows with that word in the title); the daily log files really start each day; Check-up recognises movies the renamer renamed; the background helper starts again by itself after an update - New in 1.3.56: the drop folder never replaces or doubles up what you have (it stays there, the Check-up says why); copies dubbed into another language are skipped; qBittorrent is started if it isn't running; Check-up no longer flags movies you moved or renamed; no more duplicate-column errors; quieter log - New in 1.3.55: MyTorrents.log starts a new file each day and keeps a week (it used to grow for ever) - New in 1.3.54: a first install sets qBittorrent to start with Windows, minimised to the tray - New in 1.3.53: downloads stuck at 99%+ with no seeds are checked and copied to the library anyway (When finished > Nearly finished, or right-click > Use it now); nearly finished downloads (90%+) are never thrown away as stuck, and the stuck time counts from when data last came in; a first install has good search sites ticked already - New in 1.3.52: right-click Look it up on TheTVDB / TMDb on every list (and links on the web page); Downloads: Peers and Seeds:Peers; Check-up finds sample / advert videos to delete; site advert videos left out of downloads and over-long names shortened (fixes copies that failed); Poor copies read the picture size from the name (cover pictures inside files fooled it); Movies is the first tab, My shows is now Show list, Search sites after qBittorrent - New in 1.3.51: a download you delete before it finishes is looked for again with another copy (episodes and movies); web page: sort any column, Find box, choose columns, more columns on Downloads / My shows / Wanted movies, Delete and search again - New in 1.3.50: updates really go in now (the installer stops the background helper first); drop folder - put a movie or episode there and it's filed like a download; Downloads at once (the Auto grabber and Wanted movies wait when that many are going); dead movie links swapped for another copy; Trakt list items really come off the list and are never added twice; right-click Open location / double-click on the file lists - New in 1.3.49: Check-up (once a day: everything filed is in place, in the library, not twice, not a poor copy; NAS space, search sites - with Fix it buttons; Configuration tab, MediaPortal menu, web page); Poor copies - look for a better one (swapped in once it's safely there); movie name and folder styles like the TV ones (incl. like Media Center Master) with Rename my movies to match (collections too); new show folder style; Smallest movie knows x265 copies are smaller - New in 1.3.48: Smallest movie setting (Automatic: 720p 500 MB, 1080p 1.2 GB, 4K 3 GB) so tiny poor copies are skipped; Tick all / Untick all in Stereo-only movies, Collections you could make and New movies waiting; Movies tab: Favourites box shorter with its note beside it - New in 1.3.47: Open the web page works straight away (starts the background helper itself); fixed the look-up of shows already in MP-TVSeries (new episodes go into the show's own folder again, already-have checks work); one quiet MP-TVSeries scan at night (2-5 am, never while something plays) so its start-up and every-few-minutes scans can be turned off - New in 1.3.46: Collections you could make (movies that belong together, moved into your Collections folder after your OK, plus what's missing from them); stereo-only movies - look for a 5.1 copy (the stereo one is deleted once the new one is in, or kept, your choice); TV shows tab tidied - everyday settings on the tab, the rest under More settings; Uninstall MyTorrents (was Remove); boxes grow with the window; How MyTorrents works (automatic / manual) is one line on My shows - New in 1.3.45: keeps working when MediaPortal is closed (background helper, Background tab); web page for the laptop / desktop / phone (shows, wanted movies, not found, downloads, search, search sites, settings); sound preference (surround / stereo) for TV and movies; movie favourites; tabs renamed and reordered (TV shows, Movies, My shows...), opens on the next set-up step; new movies can be filed for you after your OK; removing a wanted movie also takes it off your Trakt list - New in 1.3.44: no more Media Center Master - new movies get a .nfo with their IMDb id and can be filed for you into Movies or Collections\[collection] (TMDb through MP-TVSeries); new episodes are handed to MP-TVSeries to import straight away; Save what's not found yet as a text file - New in 1.3.43: Can't find list (episodes and movies looked for 14 days without a copy that fits, with why); OK on a show in the Auto grabber opens its menu; no more garbled pop-ups from background work; dead links try the next copy; 2 shows search at once (setting), shows you ask for never wait; movies on the NAS read in the background (Movies New often, the rest at start or when you ask - Read my movies again); bigger, resizable Configuration window; Movies tab (movie settings, Trakt list and the Wanted movies list) - New in 1.3.42: your own Trakt list (e.g. MCM) - movies go into Wanted movies and come off the list once safely in your movies folder, shows go into the Auto grabber; Torrent Search button on the Trakt plugin screens; 1080p when there is no good 720p copy (optional); fewer seeders over time when nothing turns up; stuck downloads replaced by another copy; Downloads split into Downloading and Seeding; Search again / try a different copy; Remove MyTorrents (and the programs its setup installed); already-have checks also look in the movies folder; whole seasons only for finished seasons with enough missing; Automatic or Manual at the top of the Auto grabber tab; movies are now called movies - New in 1.3.41: Wanted movies (add movies you want - downloaded when a good copy turns up); whole seasons first, then single episodes (with a season size limit and favourite season groups); what's missing for a show and a missing-episodes report for your whole library, with Grab the missing ones; Trakt lists - recommended, your watchlist, similar, trending, popular and most anticipated movies and shows; episodes you already have are not copied again from season packs - New in 1.3.40: Torrent Search from the left menu of TV Series and Moving Pictures; movie searches use their own quality (1080p) and size (2.5 GB); Add a new series (only new episodes / whole series / one season, with its folder and TVDB id file); Automatic or Manual mode (Manual for new installs) - New in 1.3.39: naming choices for finished episodes and new season folders (When finished tab, with a live example); the next episode's air date is right after a download; Airs sorts by calendar - New in 1.3.38: new episodes go into the show and season folders you already have; Check now, Search again and Remove (with Removed shows) in MyTorrents Configuration; click column headings to sort; clean-up after seeding; views in MediaPortal show again; Configuration tab renamed Torrent client - Works on 64-bit MediaPortal (.NET 4.7.2, AnyCPU) - New clients: BiglyBT (Web Remote) and qBittorrent - When finished: copies downloads into your MP-TVSeries / Moving Pictures folders, renamed and sorted; torrent keeps seeding, tagged MyTorrents-copied - Setup assistant: installs and connects qBittorrent or BiglyBT, Jackett (with sites) and FlareSolverr - Search sites tab: add your own torrent sites with just a search address - MyTorrents Configuration program + desktop icon (no need to start MediaPortal) - Downloads list in MyTorrents Configuration: progress, pause / resume, remove, columns you can drag into any order (opens on its own while MediaPortal is running) - About tab: version, credits and links - Own settings file (MyTorrents.settings.xml): change settings any time, also while MediaPortal runs - Get an episode now, just this once (any size) - in MediaPortal and on the new Shows tab - Size report (what size limit fits), smallest size to skip fakes, placeholder episodes skipped - Removing an Auto grabber download in MediaPortal offers to look for another copy; Auto grabber list A-Z - Auto grabber favourites: release groups / sites you like (e.g. MeGusta, PSA) are chosen first, or only them - Running shows in your TV folder are added to the Auto grabber by themselves (new episodes only; ended shows and shows you are far behind on are left alone; shows you remove stay removed) - Works with any skin: universal screens are added automatically to skins without MyTorrents screens - Jackett: address/API key in settings, 'all indexers' search, works with admin password - Magnet-link and redirect fixes, Deluge host fix, many crash fixes
